body:
Yesterday I went to the doctors office and was given a perscription for an 8oz bottle of codiene.  When I got home from work, my roommate and I eagerly consumed a tablespoon of codeine each.  The spoon was then cleaned off with a zig-zag, which was then set aside.  Marijuana was then wrapped in the codiene covered zig-zag and placed in a bubbler to smoke.
The result tasted strangely like cotton candy when it burned.  We both were extremely high (higher than any 'normal' weed buzz) for about an hour which was followed by a period of extreme lethargy and drowsiness.  Sleep was deep and long.  Overall a good experience although nothing earth shattering by any means.
